messages.content: 如何烹飪五隻雞的食譜？

function.name: recipe_calculator_calculate_time
function.description: Calculates the time to cook a recipe based on weight and per unit time. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

weight.description: The weight of the item to be cooked. This is a float type value.

per_unit_time.description: The time required to cook per unit weight.

unit_of_time.description: Unit of time, such as minutes or hours. Default is minutes.

message.reasoning:
The user asks: "如何烹飪五隻雞的食譜？" which means "How to cook a recipe for five chickens?" They want a recipe for cooking five chickens. We need to provide a recipe. Possibly we can ask clarifying questions? But likely they want a recipe. We can give a general recipe for roasting five chickens, maybe with seasoning, cooking time. We can also use the function to calculate cooking time: weight of each chicken times per unit time. But we don't know weight. We could assume average weight of chicken ~1.5 kg. So total weight 7.5 kg. Per unit time maybe 20 minutes per kg? That would be 150 minutes. But we can just give a recipe.

We can also ask for preferences: do they want roasted, fried, etc. But we can give a standard roast chicken recipe for five chickens. Provide steps: preheat oven, season, stuff, roast, rest, serve. Also mention cooking time: about 20 minutes per pound (or per kg). Use function to calculate time: weight=7.5, per_unit_time=20 minutes per kg? Actually typical roast chicken: 20 minutes per pound (~45 minutes per kg). But we can approximate.

We can call the function: weight=7.5, per_unit_time=45, unit_of_time="minutes". That will return something. Let's call it.
